title: Its quest for leadership has not come without notice: it was the first
columns:
NAS Airport Services
Stake: 9.1%
Sector: Food
NAS Airport Services Limited (NAS) provides meals and handling
services to airlines at the Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and
the Mombasa International Airport.
NAS is the only operator offering these services and therefore has a clear
leadership of its market.
